title: Duckling waving hello
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- Body -->
  <ellipse cx='48' cy='72' rx='24' ry='19' fill='#FFD93D'/>
  <!-- Body shading -->
  <ellipse cx='48' cy='76' rx='20' ry='13' fill='#FFC107'/>
  <!-- Wing (right side, not waving) -->
  <ellipse cx='66' cy='70' rx='10' ry='14' fill='#FFE066' transform='rotate(-15 66 70)'/>
  <!-- Head -->
  <circle cx='42' cy='44' r='18' fill='#FFD93D'/>
  <!-- Head highlight -->
  <circle cx='38' cy='38' r='10' fill='#FFE066'/>
  <!-- Left eye -->
  <circle cx='36' cy='41' r='4' fill='#3A3A5C'/>
  <circle cx='37' cy='40' r='1.5' fill='#FFFFFF'/>
  <!-- Right eye -->
  <circle cx='48' cy='41' r='4' fill='#3A3A5C'/>
  <circle cx='49' cy='40' r='1.5' fill='#FFFFFF'/>
  <!-- Beak -->
  <path d='M38 50 Q42 56 48 50 Q44 54 42 52 Z' fill='#FF8C42'/>
  <path d='M38 50 Q42 53 48 50' fill='none' stroke='#E67330' stroke-width='1'/>
  <!-- Cheek blush -->
  <circle cx='32' cy='49' r='3' fill='#FF9999' opacity='0.7'/>
  <circle cx='52' cy='49' r='3' fill='#FF9999' opacity='0.7'/>
  <!-- Waving wing (left, raised up) -->
  <ellipse cx='24' cy='35' rx='7' ry='12' fill='#FFE066' transform='rotate(-30 24 35)'/>
  <!-- Wing tip feathers -->
  <circle cx='20' cy='27' r='4' fill='#FFC107'/>
  <!-- Little feet -->
  <ellipse cx='38' cy='90' rx='7' ry='3' fill='#FF8C42'/>
  <ellipse cx='56' cy='90' rx='7' ry='3' fill='#FF8C42'/>
</svg>
